== Summary ==
Slip “•Utapau (Republic Controlled)” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 791, 581, 1513)). Version [[Utapau (Republic Controlled) / Utapau (Separatist Controlled)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
